ENGLISH — MOCK EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. quickly
   B. run
   C. happiness
   D. blue

2. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. goes
   B. going
   C. went
   D. goed

3. When practising Writing 1.5.1 Writing legibly and neatly, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.5.1 Writing legibly and neatly.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.5.1 Writing legibly and neatly.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.5.1 Writing legibly and neatly.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.5.1 Writing legibly and neatly.

4. When practising Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short Stories, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short Stories.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short Stories.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short Stories.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short Stories.

5. When practising Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word classes: Compound Nouns, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.1Extensive Reading: Independent Reading.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.1Extensive Reading: Independent Reading.

7. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the Library
   B. Where is the library?
   C. where is the library
   D. Where is the library

8. When practising Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre.

   A. Only one word repeated
   B. Many unrelated topics with no link
   C. No full stops
   D. One main idea with supporting sentences
